{{Top|leg}}
'''The Shield''' was an organization of security specialists. It was founded by [[Peert Ginzork]] and its members included [[Filice Ginzork]], [[Keal Roscon]] and [[Baarak Kalaim]]. The Shield began as a group that protected corporate couriers who had to travel among [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. It eventually branched out to handle executive [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] duties and then counter-espionage. It has been a successful independent security force.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
